title: デビュー戦の後に・狼煙を上げろ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin does a fantastic job in her debut race, but her journey has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's to be seen as a fully capable racer, she'll have to overcome one of the toughest challenges out there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes the Classic Triple Crown her main goal for next year, and to better prepare for it, we decide for her to run in the Hopeful Stakes.
